lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with intra-column spacing approximately double the diameter of the individual centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid where blobs act as high-intensity nodes within the diffuse vertical structures.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift—a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge transitioning into a shadowed gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct commensal organisms (Echeneidae) attached to the specimen: one near the branchial slits and two on the ventral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
